verdict.rationale: Ardent's pricing page documents a "$30 one-time credit" alongside a base plan with usage-based compute and storage. That lets a founder try real prototypes before paying, but it is a one-time trial credit, not an ongoing free tier. A community comment points to a paid monthly base plan beyond that credit. Missing for 10: a documented recurring free tier, stated free-tier limits (branches, compute, storage), and hands-on evidence that the credit covers a real prototype.

support.subject: As a founder, a genuinely usable free tier lets me run real prototypes before paying
